product_name_specific: RZR XP Turbo / RZR XP 4 Turbo RZR Turbo S / RZR Turbo S 4 RZR PRO XP / PRO XP 4
risk_description:
The primary (drive) clutch may fail under high-load, low speed conditions (high boost vehicle launch, high RPM belt slip, launching with simultaneous brake and throttle application).

This can cause debris and/or clutch components to be ejected from the clutch housing, increasing the risk of injury.
